Native fourth-edition source: the relabel-to-front ordering of the generic push-relabel algorithm.  A run of the algorithm is a sequence of basic operations (BasicOp), each a relabel of an overflowing vertex or an admissible push; over any run, heights are nondecreasing, the number of relabels is at most 2|V|^2, the number of saturating pushes is at most 2|V||E|, and the number of nonsaturating pushes is at most 4|V|^2(|V|+|E|) via the potential Phi = sum of heights over overflowing vertices; the combined O(V^2 E) bound on the number of basic operations is proved bound to the concrete run construction.  The relabel-to-front discharge discipline (RelabelToFrontRun) additionally proves the sharper O(V^3) bound on the number of basic operations (step_count_bound_V3).
